page.content:
Commercial towing crew that first meets the xenomorph.

How Nostromo crew connects

  • Character: Ellen Ripley — Ripley is warrant officer of the Nostromo crew.
  • Character: Dallas — Dallas captains the Nostromo crew.
  • Character: Ash — Ash serves as the Nostromo's science officer.
  • Ship: USCSS Nostromo — The crew lives and dies aboard the Nostromo.
  • Faction: Weyland-Yutani — The Nostromo crew works a Company towing contract.
  • Character: Jones — Jones is the Nostromo's surviving ship's cat.

What is Nostromo crew?

The Nostromo crew — Dallas, Ripley, Kane, Lambert, Parker, Brett, and Ash — is the first human circle broken by the facehugger and the grown xenomorph.

Key threads lead to Ellen Ripley, Dallas, Ash, USCSS Nostromo, Weyland-Yutani and Jones.
